name: Ambition
overview: Scripture reveals ambition as a driving force that can lead to rebellion and self-exaltation apart from God's will. From the desire of Eve to be 'as gods' knowing good and evil, to the builders of Babel seeking to make a name for themselves, ambition often manifests as a pursuit of personal glory rather than humble obedience. The challenges against Moses' leadership by Aaron and Miriam further illustrate how ambition can cause division when individuals seek to elevate themselves above God's appointed authority.
